BolometerParserSettings.title: Bolometer Parser Settings
BolometerParserSettings.description: RF sweep parser settings specific to a bolometer sensor.

V_off_delay.description: What time should be fit to when determining 'off' point when fitting the fast off.

V_off_function.description: What type of fit function to use when fitting to the fast off voltage of the sensor.

V_off_fit_time_window.description: The time window - relative to when power was turned off - to fit the data to. Should be large enough to capture the curve.

ThermoelectricSensorAnalysisSettings.description: Analysis settings specific to a thermoelectric sensor.

title: RFSweepParserConfig
description: Settings needed to parsed an RFsweep for a sensor, not specific to any type of sensor.

instr_timing_tolerance.description: Used for determining the relative time delays between the instrument signals for finding the 'correct' RF switching time. A typical value is 5 seconds.

RF_on_average_window.description: time window (in seconds) to average over when evaluating long timescle settled values.
